title: DueCare workbench wheels
subtitle: v0.17.0 portability bundle: workbench inventory, type catalog, media-rich samples, async process jobs, graph-edge contract, and local-first knowledge files
description: DueCare workbench wheel bundle for the core exploration notebook. The source-first install path remains GitHub release/source for maximum transparency. This local fallback now includes duecare-llm-chat 0.17.0 alongside legacy infrastructure wheels. Kernel 01 enforces the reusable portability contract before opening the UI: /api/portability, /api/audit/workbench-inventory, /api/harnesses, /api/knowledge/type-catalog, /api/process/batch/start, /api/process/batch/status/{job_id}, /api/search/sanitize, and /api/anonymize must be present. The 0.17.0 chat package includes the sample manifest, media-rich PH-HK case bundle, knowledge_files.zip import/export contract, prompt/eval training seed, model-fit profiles, trust-boundary vocabulary, process phases, and typed graph-edge contract used by 02, 03, A-00, and appendix notebooks.
